args: Analyze the stale CFG-node vulnerability in BasicBlock::tryRemoveExpressionBefore in skia/src/sksl/SkSLCFGGenerator.cpp. How are expression CFG nodes invalidated or updated during optimizer rewrites, and what is the safest minimal root-cause fix consistent with existing CFG APIs? Please identify relevant methods/files and whether removing backward CFG nodes by structural position rather than dereferencing expression slots is viable.

The reported ASan crash is a use-after-poison at line 120 while evaluating (*iter)->expression()->get() during a backward scan invoked by delete_left in skia/src/sksl/SkSLCompiler.cpp. BasicBlock nodes hold non-owning pointers to unique_ptr<Expression> slots in mutable IR. Earlier nested constructor/swizzle rewrites can destroy or move a containing expression but leave a corresponding CFG node. We need modify only C/C++ under skia, preserve optimizer behavior, and address stale slots at the root rather than merely special-casing the PoV.
